memory: I believe that finding time for family is essential, even in the midst of a demanding career. By structuring my schedule intentionally, I ensure that family time is prioritized and protected. Setting aside specific weekends for family activities allows us to recharge and create lasting memories. I also make an effort to blend business and leisure when possible, turning international deals into family trips whenever feasible. This approach provides my children with valuable cultural experiences and allows me to be present while fulfilling my professional responsibilities. It's a delicate balance, but it's one that works for us. Ultimately, my family serves as a grounding force, reminding me that wealth extends far beyond financial metrics—it's about the relationships and experiences that truly matter.
